name: Nature Connect Small Grants (Table Mountain Fund small grant facility)

funder.name: The Table Mountain Fund (WWF South Africa)

summary: Annual small grants, issued on behalf of the Table Mountain Fund, for new community groups, NPOs and individuals leading habitat restoration, indigenous planting, conservation and ecotourism projects within 50 km of Cape Town. The 2027 call has closed.

eligibility.rule: Project is based within 50 km of Cape Town CBD
A registered NPO must be in good standing and propose a new project on the focus themes
Organisation submits no more than one application
Project excludes conferences, bursaries, scholarships and large capital items

status.quote: Applications for this call closed on 19 October 2026.

administered_by.quote: Nature Connect has been appointed as a facility to issue small grants on behalf of the Table Mountain Fund (TMF).

applicant_types.quote: Registered NPOs in good standing may apply if they are proposing a new project or initiative that speaks to the focus themes. Individuals and community groups seeking to establish initiatives in the conservation or ecotourism space

geography.quote: Projects must be based in the greater Cape Town area, within 50 km of Cape Town CBD.

access.quote: All applications must be submitted through the provided online application link.

window.quote: We are now inviting applications for the 2027 funding cycle.

amount.quote: Grants of up to R36,250 per project are available.

effort.quote: Complete the online application form: Small Grants Funding Application Form
invited to present their projects in person to the review panel in November 2026.
